sec_filing_events.pit_caveat: This backfills SEC public availability by accepted_at/accession metadata. It is not a replay of what the local news pipeline or LLM actually observed.

form4_transactions.source: SEC EDGAR company submissions + Form 4 primary documents

entry_context_schema.pit_filter: context_as_of <= entry_date and underlying Form4 usable_trade_date <= context_as_of

outcome_join_schema.pit_guard: Only context rows with context_as_of <= entry_date and underlying Form 4 usable_trade_date <= context_as_of are eligible for an entry join.

pit_notes: Historical backfills lack vendor publication/as-of metadata and are marked pit_safe=false.
Forward daily snapshots are usable no earlier than the next weekday.
Open interest may have exchange/vendor lag and should not be used same-day.
OnclickMedia is a free public-source aggregation feed; use coverage and quality audits before alpha claims.
